card.name: The word drug in overdose management
card.fires_on: The word "drug" right after "multiple" or "check" in overdose-management sections of drug labels. It predicts a following noun such as ingestion, involvement or blood concentration.

modes.label: Multiple drug
modes.description: "drug" after "multiple" in advice to consider several substances being taken.
modes.example: Overdose Management Consider the possibility of multiple<< drug>> ingestion.

modes.label: Check drug level
modes.description: "drug" after "check" before "blood concentration" in lidocaine overdose text.
modes.example: If lidocaine overdose is suspected, check<< drug>> blood concentration.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward drug-related words such as drug, drugs, pharmac and the Chinese words for medicine.
